product_overview: Nuvy Finance is a multi-tenant B2B financial management SaaS for executive control of payables, receivables, reconciliation, reporting, investments, and automated financial copiloting. It provides strict tenant isolation, real-time financial intelligence, and automation via web, CSV imports, and messaging bots.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication and strict multi-tenant access control using empresa_id isolation
Enable end-to-end management of accounts payable and receivable, including bulk operations and receipt handling
Support bank statement reconciliation with CSV import and anti-duplication safeguards
Deliver executive reporting for DRE Gerencial and projected cash flow with accrual and cash-basis views
Track B3 stocks and FIIs in real time with portfolio and yield monitoring
Automate financial assistance through Telegram and WhatsApp copilots, including transcription, OCR, and receipt generation
Support SaaS administration for tenants, plans, and billing workflows

features.name: Multi-Tenant Authentication & Authorization
features.description: Allows tenant users and super administrators to authenticate securely and access only the data permitted for their company context.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials for a tenant user -> Receive 200 with JWT token and tenant context -> GET /api/profile with Authorization header -> Receive user profile scoped to empresa_id
POST /api/auth/login with invalid password -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/profile without valid token -> Receive 401 authentication error
POST /api/auth/login repeatedly with invalid credentials -> Receive rate-limited response after brute-force threshold -> GET /api/profile remains blocked without valid JWT

features.name: Financial Transactions Management
features.description: Enables creation, viewing, updating, deletion, and batch processing of accounts payable and receivable, including cost center splits and receipt attachment support.
user_flows: POST /api/transacoes with tipo=despesa or tipo=receita and valid payload -> Receive 201 with transaction record -> GET /api/transacoes/:id -> Receive transaction details including rateios and comprovante_url
PUT /api/transacoes/:id with updated values -> Receive 200 with updated transaction -> DELETE /api/transacoes/:id -> Receive 200 confirming removal
POST /api/transacoes/baixarEmLote with a list of payable/receivable IDs -> Receive 200 with bulk liquidation results and audit log reference -> GET /api/transacoes to verify updated settlement status
POST /api/transacoes/deletarLote with a valid batch of IDs -> Receive 200 with bulk deletion summary -> GET /api/transacoes to confirm deleted items are no longer returned
POST /api/transacoes with malformed rateios or missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/transacoes/:id is not created and returns 404 or no record

features.name: Bank Statement Reconciliation
features.description: Imports Brazilian bank statement CSV files, detects duplicate uploads, and matches bank entries against settled financial transactions.
user_flows: POST /api/open-finance/import with a supported CSV from Nubank, Bradesco, Itaú, Santander, BB, or Inter -> Receive 200 with parsed statement and reconciliation candidates -> GET /api/open-finance/reconciliacao -> Receive matched and unmatched entries
POST /api/open-finance/import with the same CSV file already processed -> Receive 409 duplicate file error from anti-duplication engine -> GET /api/open-finance/reconciliacao remains unchanged

POST /api/open-finance/import with CSV entries whose values match settled transactions within +/- 2 days -> Receive 200 with smart-match results -> GET /api/open-finance/reconciliacao shows auto-linked transactions
POST /api/open-finance/import with unsupported CSV format or corrupted data -> Receive 400 parse error -> GET /api/open-finance/reconciliacao returns no new reconciliation records

features.name: Financial Intelligence & Executive Reports
features.description: Provides real-time DRE Gerencial and projected cash flow reports, distinguishing accrual and cash-basis views for executive decision-making.
user_flows: GET /api/relatorios/dre?empresa_id=:id with a valid JWT and tenant context -> Receive 200 with DRE Gerencial data on accrual basis using data_competencia -> GET /api/relatorios/fluxo-caixa?empresa_id=:id&horizonte=30 -> Receive projected cash flow for 30 days using data_pagamento

GET /api/relatorios/fluxo-caixa?empresa_id=:id&horizonte=60 -> Receive 200 with 60-day cash flow projection -> GET /api/relatorios/fluxo-caixa?empresa_id=:id&horizonte=90 -> Receive 200 with 90-day projection

GET /api/relatorios/dre?empresa_id=:id without authorization -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/relatorios/fluxo-caixa?empresa_id=:id without valid tenant context -> Receive 403 or 401 access denied

GET /api/relatorios/dre?empresa_id=:id with no available transactions -> Receive 200 with empty or zeroed report -> GET /api/relatorios/fluxo-caixa?empresa_id=:id with no future cash events -> Receive 200 with empty or low-activity projection

features.name: Investments & Portfolio Tracking
features.description: Tracks B3 stocks and FIIs in real time and monitors holdings, prices, and asset yield performance.
user_flows: GET /api/investimentos/carteira with a valid JWT -> Receive 200 with current B3 portfolio positions -> GET /api/investimentos/rendimentos -> Receive 200 with updated yield and performance metrics
POST /api/investimentos/carteira with a new asset position -> Receive 201 with created investment holding -> GET /api/investimentos/carteira/:id -> Receive 200 with holding details and valuation
GET /api/investimentos/carteira with invalid or expired token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/investimentos/rendimentos without authentication -> Receive 401 access denied
POST /api/investimentos/carteira with invalid ticker or incomplete payload -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/investimentos/carteira/:id returns 404 because the asset was not created

features.name: Cora Financial Copilot (Telegram & WhatsApp)
features.description: Offers messaging-based financial assistance through Telegram and WhatsApp, including audio transcription, OCR receipt parsing, and PDF receipt generation.
user_flows: POST /api/cora/webhook/telegram with a message from @NuvyFinanca_bot -> Receive 200 acknowledgment -> POST /api/cora/transcribe with an audio payload -> Receive 200 with Whisper transcription text -> POST /api/cora/ocr with a receipt image -> Receive 200 with GPT-4o OCR-parsed expense data
POST /api/cora/webhook/whatsapp with an incoming user message -> Receive 200 acknowledgment -> POST /api/cora/receipt-pdf with parsed receipt data -> Receive 200 with generated official PDF receipt
POST /api/cora/transcribe with unsupported media or corrupted audio -> Receive 400 transcription error -> POST /api/cora/ocr with a non-receipt image -> Receive 422 parsing/recognition error
POST /api/cora/receipt-pdf with incomplete receipt fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET generated receipt URL fails or is not created

features.name: SaaS Administration & Billing
features.description: Supports super administrator workflows for managing tenant companies, plans, and subscription billing across the SaaS platform.
user_flows: GET /api/super/empresas with super admin JWT -> Receive 200 with tenant company list -> GET /api/super/planos -> Receive 200 with available plans -> GET /api/super/faturas -> Receive 200 with billing and invoice records
POST /api/super/empresas with a new tenant company payload -> Receive 201 with created company -> PUT /api/super/empresas/:id -> Receive 200 with updated tenant configuration
GET /api/super/empresas without super admin role -> Receive 403 forbidden response -> GET /api/super/faturas with insufficient permissions -> Receive 403 access denied
POST /api/super/faturas with invalid billing data or unsupported payment payload -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/super/faturas shows no new invoice created
